briefdescription.para: Breakpoint registry for DAP setBreakpoints, resolution, and DAP event builders.

detaileddescription.para: Implements all of BreakpointManager. It maps DAP breakpoint requests (file:line) to engine breakpoint IDs, keeps unresolved entries and retries them on symbol reload or module load, builds the setBreakpoints response, and builds the stopped event for a breakpoint or step stop. Path normalization helpers are file-local.
